final_assistant_text: The final review looks good: the mask follows the bright, well-circumscribed mass in all three planes, and the slices just past the mask ends show no missed lesion tissue. The three candidates (C1–C3) are thin continuations of the adjacent bright neurovascular line (vessel/nerve) beyond the tumor capsule, not part of the mass itself — I'll reject them and save.
